input.quote: 16.5 Disclaimer of Liability for Consequential Damages. UNLESS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED HEREUNDER, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY OR ANY OF ITS RESPECTIVE AFFILIATES AND THEIR RESPECTIVE OFFICERS, DIRECTORS AND EMPLOYEES BE LIABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT FOR SPECIAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES SUFFERED BY THE OTHER PARTY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT
input.rationale: Article 16 contains only a mutual consequential-damages disclaimer (16.5) with carve-outs for the Article 10/16.1/16.2 indemnities and gross negligence or willful misconduct; there is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement (searches for cap/aggregate liability language return nothing, and Section 17.3(d) only bars punitive or excess damages in arbitration). Direct liability is therefore unlimited for both Parties, including Ono, so the clause fails the fallback element requiring a mutual cap based on 12 months of fees. We have added one new Section 16.7 imposing a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement uncapped, and Ono's payment obligations excluded from capped damages. The existing mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages in 16.5 is retained and already meets that preferred element.

ops.text: 16.7 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Ono under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000; Ono's payment obligations under this Agreement shall not constitute damages subject to this cap. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations, its data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations under Article 10 and Sections 16.1 and 16.2, its gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 16 disclaims consequential damages but leaves both Parties' direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Ono's payment obligations are not damages subject to it.
proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap in Article 16 with uncapped Excluded Claims

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
